Nothing there but fog and witches.''"<br />"''Exactly.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Ratch/Legends|Ratch]] right before she killed him|<ref name="Nightsisters (episode)">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Dathomir system''' was a ten-planet system that included the planet of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Domir/Legends|Domir]].
